'''Algrunar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as an [[Jedi instructor|instructor]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. A [[Color/Legends|gray]]-[[Hair/Legends|haired]] and tan-skinned [[Human/Legends|Human]] with brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], Algrunar wore tan and gray-green [[Jedi apparel/Legends|robes]] with bronze-colored shoulder [[Armor/Legends|pauldrons]] and wielded a single [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. He was stationed on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], where he maintained a base in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Algrunar first appears as the Jedi Knight class trainer on Tatooine in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]]&ndash;[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" /> He is also mentioned in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'', though his name is misspelled Algruner.<ref name="Explore">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''</ref>
